verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev has explicit wait-for-token/approval functionality: docs describe waitpoint tokens that 'pause task runs until you complete the token' and are 'commonly used for approval workflows', plus a needsApproval flag that 'pauses for human approval; the run stays alive'. This directly matches the ops story of pausing a workflow for human input before continuing. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of this specific feature (community mentions mostly cite wait/resume as a past wishlist item rather than confirming the current implementation works well).
